open_points.subject: Owner-session expiry versus admitted requests
open_points.text: “a request carrying it is refused at the session check” / “the pass alone ends sessions by their limits, taking the import lock and then each session's lock” / “a request that passes it completes even if a limit or a sign-out comes while it runs”
open_points.question: What prevents the expiry pass from ending the session and dropping its confirmation or uploaded file after a request passes the session check but before that request acquires its locks or finishes?
options: The session check and request execution hold or pin the session until completion
The pass may end the session, but an admitted request continues from a private snapshot
The pass wins and the admitted request may subsequently be refused
open_points.default_guess: Perform the validity check under the applicable locks and prevent the expiry pass from removing session state until every already-admitted request using it completes.

open_points.subject: Expiry-pass lock scope
open_points.text: “taking the import lock and then each session's lock (A16 rule 2) and deciding under them”
open_points.question: Does one pass hold the import lock for the entire traversal, acquiring and releasing session locks one at a time, or reacquire the import lock separately for each session; and may it hold more than one session lock at once?
options: Hold the import lock for the whole pass and take one session lock at a time
Acquire the import lock and one session lock separately for each session
Hold the import lock and all session locks until the whole pass is decided
open_points.default_guess: Hold the import lock for the whole pass, acquire and release one session lock at a time, and never hold multiple session locks together.

open_points.subject: Expiry-pass schedule
open_points.text: “at a pass over the sessions it makes every 60 seconds from the start”
open_points.question: When is the first pass, and after execution delay or host/VM suspension does Registry run one immediate catch-up pass, replay every missed 60-second pass, or shift the future schedule from the delayed pass?
options: First pass after 60 seconds; run one catch-up pass and retain the original cadence
First pass immediately; replay every missed scheduled pass
First pass after 60 seconds; after delay, schedule the next pass 60 seconds after the delayed one
open_points.default_guess: Run the first pass 60 seconds after process start; after delay or suspension run one pass immediately and continue on the original monotonic 60-second cadence without replaying missed passes.
